sn56.2:1.2: A bhikkhu who is secluded understands things as they really are.
sn56.2:1.3: “And what does he understand as it really is?
sn56.2:1.4: He understands as it really is: ‘This is suffering.’… ‘This is the origin of suffering. ’… ‘This is the cessation of suffering.’… ‘This is the way leading to the cessation of suffering.’
sn56.2:1.6: A bhikkhu who is secluded understands things as they really are.
sn56.2:2.1: “Therefore, bhikkhus, an exertion should be made to understand: ‘This is suffering.’… An exertion should be made to understand: ‘This is the way leading to the cessation of suffering.’”
